products.name: Totapuri Mango Pulp
products.title: Bulk Totapuri Mango Pulp Exporter | AIVA Enterprises
products.description: High-quality Totapuri Mango Pulp from India. Aseptic drums. 14+ Brix. Cost-effective base for blended fruit beverages.
products.overview: Totapuri Mango Pulp is widely preferred in the food processing industry for its ideal blend of sweetness and acidity. Its cost-effectiveness and strong flavor make it the perfect base ingredient for multi-fruit nectars and industrial blends.
products.applications: Beverage bases, multi-fruit juices, jams, and fruit yogurts.
products.storage: Ambient temperature. Keep away from direct sunlight.

faqs.q: Why choose Totapuri over Alphonso for beverages?
faqs.a: Totapuri has a more tart flavor and is highly cost-effective, making it the perfect base for blended juices where pure Alphonso might be too expensive.

products.name: Tomato Paste
products.title: Bulk Tomato Paste Exporter (28-30 Brix) | AIVA Enterprises
products.description: Premium Cold Break & Hot Break Tomato Paste. 28-30 Brix. Exported globally from India. Ideal for ketchup and sauces.
products.overview: AIVA Enterprises processes and exports premium quality Tomato Paste, available in both Cold Break (CB) and Hot Break (HB) varieties. Our tomatoes are sourced from prime agricultural belts in India, ensuring a rich red color and excellent consistency.
products.applications: Ketchup manufacturing, pasta sauces, soups, pizza bases, and ready-to-eat meals.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Hot Break and Cold Break tomato paste?
faqs.a: Cold Break is processed at lower temperatures to retain fresh flavor and color, ideal for premium purees. Hot Break is heated to higher temperatures to inactivate enzymes, yielding a thicker paste ideal for ketchup.

faqs.q: Are the strawberries whole or sliced?
